title: Muprofita weMakomo Akavezwa
intro: Mumagwenga akaoma eArabia yekare, mumwe munhu akabuda pakati pevanhu vakakurumbira nekuda kwehunyanzvi hwavo hunoshamisa. Misha yavo yakabva padombo rakasimba, asi mwoyo yavo yakanga yakaoma kupfuura makomo avakaveza. Nhume yaMwari yakasvika nechiratidzo chimwe chete chinoshamisa - asi kuzvikudza nekusateerera zvakakonzera migumisiro inotyisa uye inokurumidza. Unogona kuziva muranda ane mukurumbira ane vanhu vakasarudza kuparadzwa pane kutungamirirwa here?
clues: Ndakatumwa semuyambiri kuvanhu vangu, ndichivadana kuti vanamate Mwari Mumwe chete.
Vanhu vangu vaigara pakati pematombo anoshamisa, vachigadzira dzimba dzakanaka kwazvo mumativi emakomo.
Ngamera hono inoshamisa yakabuda mudombo rakasimba pandakanyengetera, chiratidzo chakajeka kubva kuna Wemasimbaose.
Ndakaudza vanhu vangu kuti vagovane mvura nengamera iyi hono uye kuti vasaikuvadza.
Vanhu vangu vakarangana kurwisa ngamera hadzi, vakaigura makumbo, vachizvivharira kuparadzwa kwavo.
Kudengenyeka kwenyika kunotyisa kwakarova vanhu vangu, vakasara vakawira pasi vasina kufamba mudzimba dzavo.

outcome.label: Chii chaive mugumo wavo wekupedzisira?
options: Kudengenyeka kwenyika kwakangoerekana kwaitika kubva kudenga
outcome.answer: Kudengenyeka kwenyika kwakangoerekana kwaitika kubva kudenga

arabic: وَإِن يُكَذِّبُوكَ فَقَدْ كَذَّبَتْ قَبْلَهُمْ قَوْمُ نُوحٍۢ وَعَادٌۭ وَثَمُودُ
verse: And if they deny you, [O Muḥammad] - so, before them, did the people of Noah and ʿAad and Thamūd deny [their prophets], (22:42)
